sections.title: One site. Every brand you sell.
sections.body: Most dealers carry more than one OEM. Buzznerd builds a single site with an interactive location finder — buyers filter by brand and the services they need, and get routed to the right rooftop. We also custom-build OEM spec'd brand pages on your site, so each manufacturer's inventory and identity gets its own dedicated home.

sections.title: Every page is a lead path.
sections.body: Clear calls to action, easy forms, strong inventory pages, and department-specific lead paths — conversion is built in, not bolted on. And when your team is offline, AI coverage answers inbound questions so no lead goes cold overnight.

sections.title: Your most valuable storefront.
sections.body: Your website is the hub of everything you do online — and the more your inventory, leads, and sold units flow through it, the smarter discovery, ranking, and follow-up get. Results build season over season, not just at launch.

items.question: Can Buzznerd build one website for a dealership that sells multiple brands?
items.answer: Yes. We build a single site with an interactive location finder, so buyers filter by OEM brand and the services they need and get routed to the right rooftop. We also custom-build OEM spec'd brand pages so each manufacturer's inventory and identity gets its own dedicated home.

items.question: Does a Buzznerd website connect to my existing DMS and tools?
items.answer: Yes. Buzznerd integrates with the platforms dealers already rely on — including Karmak and CDK — plus custom DMS and ERP integrations, so your inventory, leads, and sold units flow through one connected platform.

items.question: What does it mean that Buzznerd sites are optimized for AI?
items.answer: Every site is built for SEO, AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), GEO (local/generative visibility), and AIO (AI Optimization) — clean structure, inventory schema, and content shaped to be the answer when buyers ask ChatGPT, Gemini, or Google AI for a unit or service, so your dealership gets named, not skipped.

items.question: How does a Buzznerd website help me generate more leads?
items.answer: Every page is a lead path — clear calls to action, easy forms, strong inventory pages, and department-specific lead capture. An AI Assistant answers buyer questions around the clock and hands warm leads to your team.

items.question: What types of dealerships does Buzznerd work with?
items.answer: Buzznerd builds AI-enabled websites for commercial truck, trailer, equipment, and parts dealerships, including multi-location and multi-brand operations. We power 700+ rooftops and hold a 4.8 rating on Google.

items.question: Can I see it on my own inventory before committing?
items.answer: Yes. Book a 20-minute demo, no slides — we'll walk your actual site and show you where leads are leaking today and what a Buzznerd build would change.
